schema.devices: {phoenix, fez}: one entry per device of the coherence run (2026-10-02)
schema.coords: drawing (x, y) of every qubit, index = qubit
schema.calibration: summary statistics of the calibration at submission
schema.qubits: per qubit {t1_us, t2_us, readout_error} at submission; null = not reported
schema.names: circuit names in job order (= keys of the stored counts)
schema.info: per circuit: transpiled depth, two-qubit gates, swaps
schema.A: experiment A (full-lattice K_a): addresses = address qubits in analysis order; degree[i] = number of data neighbours of addresses[i]; enc = tessa Encoding of the z_image circuit (tessa.codec.Encoding.from_dict); pad = zero slots after the image; K_exact.{image,reference}[i] = exact K of addresses[i]
schema.B: experiment B (pixel pairs on disjoint couplers): matching[e] = [data, address] qubits of coupler e; pairs[p] = [direction h|v, [r, c], [r', c']] (horizontal pairs first, row-major, then vertical); values[p] = the two pixel values; batches[b] = [[p, e], ...] pairs measured in circuit pairs_b on coupler e; K_exact[p] = cos(pi (v0 - v1) / 2); K_exact_reference = cos(pi * 0.005)
